statement: For every pair of integers m>=2 and ell>=1 with m<=2ell+3, the graph J_{m,ell}=K_ell vee H_m defined in source.md is resistance-positive. More precisely, J_{m,ell} has an explicit Hamiltonian cycle when m<=2ell+2; when m=2ell+3, the seven rational edge-orbit marginals stated in evidence/boundary_certificate.md lie in the relative interior of its spanning-tree polytope and have incident sum strictly below two at every vertex.
contribution: This supplies the full positive half of the frozen threshold question. The boundary certificate is exact for every ell>=1: all proper nontrivial spanning-tree rank inequalities have slack at least 1/((ell+2)(3ell+4)). Together with the source's Proposition 16, the result yields the exact RP threshold m<=2ell+3. Novelty remains status-uncertain pending the required independent mathematical and literature audit.
